propositions: CodeQL reports high-severity incomplete-url-substring-sanitization alerts on lines 249-250 of test_llm_fallback_chain.py due to startswith checks on URL strings
The test assertions use URL prefix matching (startswith) which incorrectly accepts hosts that share the endpoint as a prefix (e.g., https://fallback.test.evil.example)
URL origin comparison must extract and match the scheme and netloc tuple exactly using urllib.parse.urlsplit to eliminate substring semantics
The fallback endpoint value must be single-sourced to prevent drift between the configured endpoint used in build_fallback_model and the value asserted in the test
